== L3 Routing ============================================================
[046] Interior gateway protocol: OSPFv2 single area 0
      Why: The design is a single autonomous system with 24 subnets (< 50), so one LSDB stays small and SPF runs in milliseconds. A link-state protocol gives sub-second-to-seconds convergence without the hop-count limits and slow count-to-infinity behaviour of distance-vector RIP, and avoids the ABR/summarisation complexity that multi-area would add with no scaling benefit.
      Ref: RFC 2328 (OSPFv2)
[047] OSPF reference bandwidth: auto-cost reference-bandwidth 100000
      Why: The default 100 Mbps reference gives FastEthernet, 1G and 10G links the same cost (1). Raising it to 100 Gbps makes cost = 100000 / link Mbps, so 10G = 10, 1G = 100 and SPF prefers the faster path. Must be identical on every router.
      Ref: RFC 2328 Appendix C.3
